messages.subject: R receives 26 slots for GSoC 2015
parts:
R GSoC has received 26 project slots from Google, more than any prior
year.

We received 79 student proposals this year.

Between now and the 24th, we need to finalize slot allocations.

Mentors, as I've said in prior emails, your opinion matters, now
especially at the interface near the accept/don't accept boundary, or
where there are two or more proposals for a project (there are many
instances of this). You should also make sure that you have scored and
commented privately on your preferred proposal for your projects, and
communicate privately with other mentors where appropriate.

Students: please pay attention to public comments on your proposals.
You may still receive them as we finalize allocations.

Regards,

Brian
